Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly assumed that the presence of an "[other]" link in the ArXiv metadata implies the availability of a PostScript (.ps) file. In reality, ArXiv typically provides PDF, HTML, and sometimes source code (like TeX) or other specific formats, but rarely PostScript directly in the main listing view for modern submissions, or the "other" link might point to a different format entirely. The agent failed to verify the specific file extension of the "other" link or search for ".ps" explicitly, leading to a false positive count of 97 (the total number of articles) instead of the correct count of 31.
